authority: Visual states are pure projections of committed story completion. Acknowledgement and reduced-motion preferences may be stored, but visual truth is never independently granted.

changes.intent: The Waystone reads as awake and as the persistent First Covenant objective hub.
changes.fallback: Keep the existing crystal art and add an accessible objective-status label only.

changes.intent: The lower road reads as passable without implying the Gatehouse activity is active.
changes.fallback: Show a compact road-open status in the Village objective panel.

changes.intent: The plaza reads as receiving regular travelers and commerce.
changes.fallback: Reveal discovered facility icons without changing the background artwork.

changes.intent: The Archives reads as occupied and preserving recovered records.
changes.fallback: Use the discovered Archives icon and a records-recovered status.

changes.intent: The Command Center reads as a place where shared decisions are recorded.
changes.fallback: Use the discovered Command Center activity icon and petition status.

changes.intent: The bridge reads as carrying supervised traffic.
changes.fallback: Show a bridge-traffic Chronicle badge without animated travelers.

changes.intent: The entrance reads as connected to harbor caravans and cultivated supply routes.
changes.fallback: Expose the Gatehouse and Gardens discovery states with compact status text.

changes.intent: The whole Village carries a modest, lasting sign that the First Covenant is complete.
changes.fallback: Persist a First Covenant crest in the objective panel, Chronicle, and Waystone sheet.

projectionRules: Recompute active visual change IDs after load, import, recovery, and story migration from validated scene completion only.
Never remove an achieved visual change because artwork or a later facility phase is unavailable.
Never create production state from provisional art/CSS identifiers.
Reduced-motion mode uses static replacements and no looping glow, parallax, camera move, or automatic pan.
Each change must have an accessible text equivalent and must remain legible at 320 by 568 and 390 by 844.
